title: Scar Tissue Fetch.ai front-end schema
description: Message contract for the Scar Tissue Fetch.ai uAgent (agents/fetch_agent.py). Other coding agents and UIs integrate against this schema. The agent serves only published lessons: rules distilled from failures, kept because removing them measurably lowered the pass rate (ablation), then promoted after a passing held-out evaluation.

transport.http: POST /lessons with a LessonQuery JSON body, returns a LessonReply JSON body
transport.auth: When SCAR_AGENT_TOKEN is set on the agent, LessonQuery.token must match it; unauthorized queries return an empty lessons list with alive/pruned counts only.

task.description: Natural-language description of the caller's task. Matched against lesson embeddings (vector cosine; Atlas $vectorSearch when configured).

k.description: Maximum number of specific lessons to return, plus up to 2 global lessons.

token.description: Shared token; required only when the agent sets SCAR_AGENT_TOKEN.

canary.description: When true, the reply may additionally include at most one canary lesson (survived ablation, not yet promoted by a passing held-out eval).

text.description: The rule to inject into the caller's prompt.

scope.description: global = applies to every task; specific = retrieved for this task by vector similarity.

value.description: Measured value: cumulative ablation delta plus 0.05 per re-discovery. Higher passed more with/without probes.

lessons.description: Published lessons ranked by measured value (best first); at most one canary lesson when the query set canary=true.

alive.description: Lessons currently alive in the library (canary + published + held).

pruned.description: Lessons deleted by ablation or retired by governance.

query.task: write a function that splits a bill between people

lessons.text: When splitting a total evenly into shares, give the leftover remainder to the first shares, one each: 1000 split 3 ways -> [334, 333, 333].
